Custom.SalesDescription.newValue:
Crew Scheduling on the Customer Service Order Planning Board

Adds crew-based scheduling to the Customer Service Order Planning Board, removing the need to manually select individual technicians for every Customer Service Order when the same crew composition repeats across assignments.

A new system setting under System Setup > Scheduling > Technician Trips ù Allow Scheduling Crews on Customer Service Order Planning Board ù controls the feature. When disabled, the Customer Service Order Planning Board behaves exactly as it does today. When enabled, the following behaviour applies.

The existing Technicians tab on the Customer Service Order Planning Board panel is relabeled Technicians/Crews and gains a toggle to switch between Technicians view and Crews view. In Technicians view, only technicians who are not members of any crew are listed; technicians belonging to a crew are excluded from this list and reappear automatically if removed from all crews. Scheduling a technician from this view works exactly as it does today.

In Crews view, the panel lists available crews. Dragging a crew onto a Customer Service Order opens the scheduling modal with a dedicated Crew Assignment tab. The crew that was dragged is pre-selected in the Crew field, and all default crew members are pre-selected in the technician list. A Support Techs option allows additional technicians outside the crew to be added for that specific assignment. Removing or adding technicians in this modal affects only the resulting technician trip ù the underlying crew record is not modified. If all original crew members are removed, the trip is created without a crew association. The default crew composition applies fresh for each assignment and does not carry forward to subsequent scheduling actions.

Before confirming a crew assignment, each selected technician is checked for overlapping scheduled trips or blocked time using the same conflict-detection logic applied on the Technician Planner. If any conflict is detected, the entire assignment is blocked and a notification identifies each conflicting technician. No partial scheduling of the non-conflicting technicians occurs.

Crews can be created and edited directly within the Customer Service Order Planning Board. A New Crew button above the Crews list opens a modal where a crew name and at least one technician must be selected before the crew can be saved. Existing crews can be edited via an edit icon on each crew card, which opens the same modal with the current name and members pre-populated; the save action is enabled only when a change is detected.

The Crew Planner is also updated to surface the technician multiselect on crew trip edit tiles when the system setting is enabled, allowing the technician list on a trip to be adjusted independently of the crew's default membership.
Custom.SalesDescription.oldValue:
Crew Scheduling on the Customer Service Order Planning Board

Adds crew-based scheduling to the Customer Service Order Planning Board, reducing the manual effort of individually selecting technicians for each Service Order when the same crew composition repeats across assignments.

A new system setting under System Setup > Scheduling > Technician Trips enables crew scheduling on the Customer Service Order Planning Board. When disabled, the Planning Board behaves exactly as it does today. When enabled, the existing Technicians tab is relabeled Technicians/Crews and a toggle appears allowing schedulers to switch between Technicians view and Crews view.

In Technicians view, the list filters to show only technicians who are not members of any crew, removing the need to visually identify unassigned technicians manually. Technicians removed from all crews reappear in this list automatically.

In Crews view, crews are displayed as cards showing crew name, member count, and utilization. Dragging a crew onto a Service Order opens the scheduling modal with a Crew Assignment tab. The crew that was dragged is pre-selected in the Crew field, and all default crew members are pre-selected in the technician list. A Support Techs option allows additional technicians outside the crew to be added for that specific assignment. Any technician can be deselected or swapped within the modal without affecting the crew's default membership ù the adjustment applies only to the technician trip being created. The default crew composition is applied fresh each time a crew is dragged onto a Service Order.

Before confirming the assignment, each selected technician is checked for overlapping scheduled trips or blocked time using the same conflict-detection logic applied on the Technician Planner. If any conflict exists, the entire assignment is blocked and a notification identifies each conflicting technician by name. No partial scheduling of non-conflicting technicians occurs.

Crews can be created and edited directly within the Planning Board. A New Crew button above the crew list opens a panel where a crew name and at least one technician must be specified before the crew can be saved. An edit control on each crew card opens the same panel pre-populated with the crew's current name and members, and the update action becomes available once a change is detected.

The Crew Planner trip tile edit view also gains a technician multi-select ù visible only when the system setting is enabled ù showing all technicians currently included in the crew trip. If all original crew members are removed from a trip, the crew association is cleared and the trip is no longer linked to a crew record.

A Support Techs option allows additional technicians outside the crew to be added for that specific assignment. Removing or adding technicians in this modal has no effect on the crew record itself ù changes apply only to the trip being created.

Existing crews have an edit icon on their card that opens the same popup with current values pre-populated; the update action is enabled only when a change is detected.

The Crew Planner also gains a technician multi-select on trip tile edit when the system setting is enabled, allowing the technician list on an existing crew trip to be adjusted independently of the crew's default membership. If all original crew members are removed from a trip ù whether at creation or on edit ù the trip is unlinked from the crew record.

A new system setting under System Setup > Scheduling > Technician Trips, Allow Scheduling Crews on Customer Service Order Planning Board, controls the feature. When disabled, the Customer Service Order Planning Board behaves exactly as it does today. When enabled, the following behavior applies.

The existing Technicians tab on the planning board panel is relabeled Technicians/Crews and gains a toggle to switch between a Technicians view and a Crews view. The Technicians view shows only technicians who are not members of any crew. Technicians belonging to a crew are excluded from this list automatically and reappear if removed from all crews. Scheduling an individual technician from this view works identically to the current behavior.

In Crews view, the panel lists available crews. Dragging a crew onto a Customer Service Order opens the scheduling modal with a Crew Assignment tab. The crew that was dragged is pre-selected in a Crew field, and all default members of that crew are pre-selected in the technician list. A Support Techs option allows additional technicians outside the crew to be added for that assignment. Removing or adding technicians in this modal does not alter the crew record itself ù changes apply only to the specific trip being created. If all original crew members are removed, the resulting trips are not linked to any crew.

Before confirming, each selected technician is checked for overlapping scheduled trips or blocked time using the same conflict-detection logic as the Technician Planner. If any conflict is found, the entire assignment is blocked and a notification identifies each conflicting technician. No partial scheduling occurs.

Crews can be created and edited directly from the Crews view. A New Crew button opens a modal where a crew name and at least one technician must be specified before the crew can be saved. Existing crews have an edit control on their card that opens the same modal with the current name and members pre-populated, enabling updates without leaving the planning board. When crew scheduling is enabled, the Crew Planner trip edit panel also exposes a technician multi-select reflecting the technicians currently included in the trip.

If no conflicts are found, individual technician trips are created for all selected technicians and linked to the crew.

The Crew Planner trip edit panel also gains a technician multiselect ù visible only when the system setting is enabled ù reflecting the current technician list for that crew trip, which may differ from the crew's default membership after per-trip adjustments.

Adds crew-based scheduling to the Customer Service Order Planning Board, removing the need to manually select individual technicians for every Service Order when the same crew composition repeats across assignments.

Dragging a crew onto a Service Order opens the standard scheduling modal with an additional Crew Assignment tab. The tab shows the dragged crew pre-selected in a Crew field, all crew members pre-selected in the technician list, and a Support Techs option that opens a secondary picker for adding technicians from outside the crew. A local search field is available to filter the list. Removing or adding technicians in this modal applies only to the trip being created; the crew record itself is not modified, and the default membership is applied fresh for each subsequent assignment.

Before the trip is created, each selected technician is checked for an overlapping scheduled trip or blocked time in the target date and time range using the same conflict-detection logic as the Technician Planner. If any conflict is found, the entire assignment is blocked and a notification identifies each affected technician. No partial scheduling occurs.

Crews can be created and edited directly from the Crews view. A New Crew button opens a modal where a crew name and at least one technician must be specified before the crew can be saved. An edit control on each crew card opens the same modal with the existing name and members pre-populated; the save action is enabled only when a change is detected.

The Crew Planner trip tile editor is also updated when the system setting is enabled, adding a technician multi-select that reflects the current technician list on the crew trip, which may differ from the crew's default membership. If all original crew members are removed from a trip, the crew association is cleared from that trip automatically, whether during initial creation or a subsequent edit.

A new setting under System Setup > Scheduling > Technician Trips, Allow Scheduling Crews on Customer Service Order Planning Board, controls the feature. When disabled, the Customer Service Order Planning Board behaves exactly as it does today. When enabled, the following behaviour applies.

The existing Technicians tab on the planning board panel is relabeled Technicians/Crews and gains a toggle to switch between Technicians view and Crews view. In Technicians view, only technicians who are not members of any crew are shown, removing the need to manually identify unaffiliated technicians. Scheduling a technician from this view works exactly as it does today. In Crews view, the panel lists available crews with member count and utilization. Dragging a crew onto a Customer Service Order opens the scheduling modal with a dedicated Crew Assignment tab. The dragged crew is pre-selected in the Crew field, and all default crew members appear pre-selected in the technician list. Schedulers can deselect members or add support technicians from outside the crew for that specific assignment without altering the crew's default membership. Each assignment starts fresh from the crew's defaults, so per-trip adjustments do not carry forward.

Before confirming the assignment, each selected technician is validated against existing scheduled trips and blocked time in the target date and time range, using the same conflict-detection logic as the Technician Planner. If any technician has a conflict, the entire assignment is blocked and a notification identifies each conflicting technician by name. No partial assignments are created.

Crews can be created and edited directly from the Crews view panel without leaving the planning board. A New Crew button opens a modal where a crew name and at least one technician must be provided before the crew can be saved. An edit icon on each crew card opens the same modal pre-populated with the crew's current name and members, and the update action becomes available only when a change is detected.

On the Crew Planner, when this setting is enabled, the trip tile edit panel exposes a technician multi-select showing all technicians currently included in that crew trip, which may differ from the crew's default membership if per-trip adjustments were made at scheduling time. If all original crew members are removed from a trip, the crew association is cleared and the resulting trips are not linked to any crew record.
